data.narrative:
Plantd Materials is a Series B-stage housing and construction company founded by Nathan Silvernail, Huade Tan, and Josh Dorfman. The firm has raised $42M to date. The comparable universe consists of four private-stage peers in the sector (Cuby Technologies, Cover, Somos, and Charge Robotics); no direct public comparables are available.

Given the limited methodological availability, analysis relies on stage-progression methodology. Using total capital raised of $42M as a valuation proxy, application of a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement produces an implied valuation of $80M. This single-method result constrains confidence relative to a multi-method triangulation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $68M (low) to $92M (median $80M), anchored to the stage-progression output. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue, profitability, or growth-rate data; reliance on a single applicable method; and lack of public market reference points in the housing-tech sector. Refinement would benefit from additional comparable transaction data, unit economics, or revenue multiples from the private peer set.
